bugs.text: After a single-ship capture the Boss stays forever in tractorPhase CAPTURE, hovering at y=128 with its beam drawn; it never returns to formation, the captive never fires, and because formationComplete now stays false no further dives (and no breathing) happen for the rest of the stage until the player shoots that Boss.
Challenging Stage wave bonus (1,000 per whole wave) is computed and shown but never added to the score; the 10,000 PERFECT bonus is not implemented (only the text).
Returning divers recompute a random Bezier control point every frame, so they visibly jitter while flying back to their slot.
Breathing is tied to 'all enemies in formation', so the formation snaps between scaled and unscaled positions each time a dive starts or ends.
Dives only start when every enemy is in formation, so at most one dive group is ever active; the stage scaling of aggression is limited by this.
Ramming a full-health Boss only removes one hit point; the rammed Boss survives.
Stage badges show one flag per denomination reached instead of the arcade's sum of denominations.
Captured fighter fires continuously while its Boss sits in formation, not only when it dives.
sfxEnemyHit is defined but never used.
Zako and Goei sprites are almost identical round blobs; the wing animation is barely visible.
A tractor beam hitting a dual fighter explodes one half instead of pulling it up, and the Boss returns with a captive.

summary: A tidy, well-organised single file with a proper fixed-timestep loop, clean state/update/render separation, a crisp integer-scaled 3:4 canvas, a twinkling starfield, a complete HUD, title/score table, stage intro, game-over results and a localStorage high score; it loaded and ran 90 s of bot play with no errors. The core loop (curved group entries, two-shot limit, aimed dives that wrap back to their slots, escort scoring, two-hit Boss, dual fighter and challenge stages) is present, but it feels like a simplified sketch of Galaga: the enemies are coloured blobs rather than insects, breathing snaps on every dive, returning divers jitter, only one dive group flies at a time, and the signature capture sequence breaks after the ship is taken (the Boss hovers forever under its beam and all dives stop until it is shot). The Challenging Stage awards only the per-hit points; the wave and PERFECT bonuses are display-only or missing, and stage badges do not follow the arcade's denominations.
